name: ftransfer
description: Private file transfer on Cloudflare Workers + R2

scripts.typecheck: pnpm run types && tsc -p . && tsc -p client --noEmit

BUCKET.description: Private R2 bucket for files, secrets and links. Keep public access off.

UPLOAD_PASSWORD.description: Passphrase for uploading: 12+ characters, e.g. 4-5 random words. Recipients don't need it. Values starting with `change-me` are refused.

SESSION_SECRET.description: Random key that signs login cookies: 32+ characters, e.g. from `openssl rand -base64 32`. Changing it signs everyone out.
